questions.issue: 'te coloca' is ambiguous: puts you in your place, or gets you high/turned on. I rendered it as 'sets you straight' (puts you in place); could be 'gets you high'.
'pelaso' = big/great hair (also the song title); rendered as 'big hair flying'. Not sure if it also means 'bald'/'by a hair'.

Wordplay: 'machacarte' (crush you) + 'sin mancharme' (without staining myself), with 'ma-'/'man-' likely hinting at macho/man. I split it in English as 'smash-ing... stain-ed'; the pun is only approximated.
'gasolina' probably references the reggaeton hit 'Gasolina' (dame mas gasolina); kept as 'gasoline'.

questions.original: kien te dijo questoy pa tu maaan
questions.issue: 'man' could be 'mano' (hand, matching 'tocar') or English 'man' (your man). I took 'your man'; the Basque version follows that too.
